{"title":"Kubernetes","summary":"For the CKAD first, and the CKA later. The exam is done in a terminal, so recall on the boards comes with tasks to do on a cluster of your own."}

{"title":"The core group","body":"Pods, Services, ConfigMaps and the other original resources belong to the core API group, which has no name. Their apiVersion is therefore just v1, where every other group's is group/version, as in apps/v1.","sources":[{"title":"API Overview: API groups","url":"https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/using-api/#api-groups"}]}
{"title":"An init container that seeds a shared volume","brief":"Add an init container to an existing Deployment so that nginx starts with content already in its volume."}
{"title":"A readiness probe that runs a command","brief":"Create a Pod that reports Ready only while a marker file exists, with the probe's timing set exactly."}
{"title":"Size a rollout, release a bad image, roll back","brief":"Set a Deployment's surge and unavailability limits, push an image that never becomes ready, read the history and undo it."}
{"title":"Move a password into a Secret","brief":"Replace a plain-text environment variable with one read from a Secret, leaving the other variables as they are."}
{"title":"A ServiceAccount that can only read Pods","brief":"Write a Role for reading Pods and their logs, bind it to a ServiceAccount, and prove with kubectl auth can-i that it can't do more."}
{"title":"Route a host name to a Service","brief":"Create an Ingress that sends one host to an existing Service, and check it with curl."}

{"title":"A Deployment, field by field","summary":"A Deployment with a readiness probe, resource requests, settings from a ConfigMap and a scratch volume. Fill in the field names: the place of each one in the manifest is what you are learning."}
{"note":"The API group and version of a Deployment."}
{"note":"Which Pods the Deployment owns. It must match the template's labels, and can't be changed later."}
{"note":"The port the container listens on. Informational: leaving it out doesn't stop traffic."}
{"note":"Turns every key of a ConfigMap into an environment variable at once."}
{"note":"Decides whether the Pod receives Service traffic. Failing it never restarts the container."}
{"note":"How long after the container starts before the first probe."}
{"note":"What the scheduler reserves for the container on a node."}
{"note":"Which of the Pod's volumes the container uses, and where."}
{"note":"The path inside the container where the volume appears."}
{"note":"The Pod's volumes, declared once at Pod level, beside containers."}
{"note":"A scratch volume that starts empty and lives as long as the Pod."}
